create_TeacherController: create a TeacherController with a specified teacher algorithm, environment parameter bounds, and optional seed
call_set_env_params: call set_env_params on a TeacherController to sample tasks and reset the environment with new parameters
call_record_train_episode: call record_train_episode on a TeacherController to log a reward and update the task generator
convert_param_vec_to_dict: convert a flat parameter vector into a named parameter dictionary using param_vec_to_param_dict
dump_TeacherController: dump a TeacherController state including training data and task generator to a pickle file
